title: This Chrome extension gives you Unlimited AI Context and helps you switch between Models instantly
description:
This Chrome extension called Promptive Sentry lets you switch between Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini the second any of them hits a rate limit.

Here's how it works:

The moment your Claude chat gets too long, or it hits its daily limit, you click Save Context.

It reads your entire conversation and creates a context summary.

Every message, every memory, every custom instruction, all bundled into one capsule.

Think of it like packing a suitcase before switching hotels.

Nothing gets left behind, and you don't have to repack from scratch when you arrive somewhere new.

Then you switch to your next AI, ChatGPT or Gemini, and load that summary in.

It auto-injects everything instantly.

Your conversation continues right where you left off. Like nothing ever happened.

No re-explaining your project, your tone, or the fifteen things you already told the last AI.

The core memory feature works with a free local vault, so you can start using it immediately without paying anything upfront.

Your saved contexts stay stored privately on your device, not on some server you don't control.

It also tracks your Claude usage in real time.

So you can see exactly how close you are to hitting a limit before it actually happens, instead of getting cut off mid-conversation.

For anyone juggling multiple AI tools daily, this solves the most annoying part of switching platforms, the re-explaining.

Writers, developers, and researchers running the same project across different AI tools save the most time here

#aiextension #Claudeai #aicontext #promptivesentry #aimemory
